item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:15 HKT 30/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will moderate slightly tomorrow, but the weather will still be cool in the morning over the coast of Guangdong. It will be milder during the day. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. Meanwhile, the band of clouds associated with the area of low pressure over the southern part of the South China Sea will cover the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of another surge of the dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be cool in the morning and at night and it will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week.
